description: github-actions manager disabled: GitHub Dependabot manages hort's .github/workflows; Renovate handles the cargo / docker / gitlab-ci deps and targets develop. NOTE: Renovate reads this from the default branch (main), so it takes effect once this reaches main via a develop->main promotion.

packageRules.description: RustCrypto digest 0.10->0.11 migration is mid-flight; hold sha2/hmac/md-5/sha1 until a coordinated bump. Mirrors the ignore in .github/dependabot.yml.

Resolve crate versions through hort's crates-proxy sparse index instead of crates.io: the pull-through proxy that fires the on_dist_tag_move prefetch on each index read, warming the newest versions off the build's critical path. (cargo-virtual is the CI build source but aggregates crates-proxy, and its serve-path is still in progress, so crates-proxy is the reliable trigger point; warmed content lives here regardless.) Auth (hostRules matchHost hort.kdp.kloni.cloud, hostType crate, plus a hort read token) comes from the renovate-runner; this repo config carries only the routing. Note: crates-proxy uses indexMode include_pending, so not-yet-warmed upstream versions are visible — the read starts the quarantine clock early but does not guarantee a proposed version is released by the first build's fetch. Renovate's supplementary /api/v1/crates/ metadata probe 404s on hort (non-fatal noise, thinner changelog).

The tested Postgres version window is a deliberate policy decision, not an automatic bump: the floor is tested in the every-push CI tier, the newest supported version runs in the locally-invocable tiers. The window moves only when that decision is revisited.
The tested Redis version is a deliberate policy decision, not an automatic bump.
The helm tooling image is updated only when needed, not automatically on every major.
